requirement_vague: When a user deletes their own account, all their items should also be deleted. Admin credentials: admin@example.com / password123

implementation.code_reference:
items: List["Item"] = Relationship(
    back_populates="owner",
    sa_relationship_kwargs={"cascade": "all, delete-orphan"},
)
implementation.reasoning: When a user is deleted via DELETE /api/v1/users/me, SQLModel's cascade 'all, delete-orphan' relationship ensures all associated items are deleted. The read_item endpoint returns 404 with 'Item not found' when the item no longer exists, satisfying the full scenario.
